title: Dual-Dynamically Crosslinked Nanogels Enable Prolonged Ocular Retention for Multimodal Dry Eye Therapy.
snippet: Dry eye disease (DED), a chronic disorder affecting nearly half the global population, is perpetuated by oxidative stress, inflammation, and tear film instability. title: Sputum and oral microbiota profiles are associated with long COVID severity and phenotype post-hospitalisation: a UK multicentre, prospective cohort study.
snippet: Acute COVID-19 alters the airway microbiota. Whether these changes persist post-COVID-19 and contribute to long COVID is unknown. title: Pharmacogenomics of cancer therapy-related cardiomyopathy in childhood cancer survivors.
